sloka: निश्चितार्थस्ततस्तस्मिन् सुग्रीवः पवनात्मजे ।लक्ष्मणः प्रीतिमान् प्रीतं बहुमानादवैक्षत ।। ५.६४.३८ ।।।।
transliteration: niścitārthastatastasmin sugrīvaḥ pavanātmaje ।lakṣmaṇaḥ prītimān prītaṁ bahumānādavaikṣata ।। 5.64.38 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing the nectarlike words from Hanuman that Sita was found, Rama and Lakshmana were delighted.
